response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js production experience and recent, directly relevant exposure to MCP servers and agentic-workflow infrastructure at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, while his AI/GenAI experience appears limited to roughly the past year, and the resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, or LLM optimization. His teaching, workshops, and staff-level tenure suggest customer-facing and mentorship capability, but the AI depth gap is significant for a staff-level GenAI-focused role.
strengths: Current hands-on work with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow frameworks
15+ years of production engineering with strong TypeScript/Node.js and full-stack breadth
Proven mentorship and communication skills via workshops, talks, and courses
concerns: Falls well short of the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1 year of GenAI work)
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
Limited evidence of deep cloud-platform AI system design (only light AWS CDK usage mentioned)

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering seniority and mentorship track record
